create_atomicdata_from_ase_atoms: create an AtomicData graph object from an ASE Atoms object with optional neighbor cutoff and max neighbors
convert_atomicdata_to_ase_atoms: convert a single-graph AtomicData object back to an ASE Atoms object with forces and energy
create_atomicdata_from_dict: create an AtomicData object from a Python dictionary containing required keys like pos, atomic_numbers, and cell
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into one contiguous batched AtomicData object
extract_example_from_batched_atomicdata: extract a single AtomicData object at a given index from a batched AtomicData object
